# Cyber Dragon (`v1.1.0`)

> Explainable, SSRF-free defensive cybersecurity platform for phishing links, IDN homographs, USSD call-forwarding traps, and Mobile Money social engineering.

- Threat Studio: https://codesphere-u.github.io/cyber-dragon/studio.html
- Benchmark Proof: https://codesphere-u.github.io/cyber-dragon/proof.html
- Detection Rules: https://codesphere-u.github.io/cyber-dragon/rules.html
- Documentation: https://codesphere-u.github.io/cyber-dragon/docs.html
